answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The umber of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The prism is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the onyx.
